title: muND extraction task
description: extraction/<task>/task.json: one source (publication) whose values are extracted twice, independently (input-A.json, input-B.json), compared and adjudicated (adjudication.json) before they are published to data/. See docs/extraction.ja.md. The order of the properties below is the canonical key order of the file.

id.description: Name of the task; equal to the name of its directory under extraction/.

publications.description: Written by the data entry tool when approved values are published to data/: which entries were written from which approved content. Not part of the approved content.

doi.description: A DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix (placeholders 10.1000/mund.<name> as in the data files).

source.description: The source that is read. Only its identity is recorded: the PDF itself and text copied from it are never stored in the repository.

bibId.description: Main reference of the source (becomes meta.bibId of the published data).

version.description: Which version was read, as free text: journal version, arXiv:2501.05897v2, accepted manuscript ...

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF file that was read.

size.description: Size of that PDF file in bytes.

items.description: The tables, figures and text passages of the source that may hold values. Every input marks each of them (coverage).

label.description: As the source names it: 'Table 2', 'Fig. 3', 'text p. 5' ... Unique within the task.

page.description: Page (as printed, or the page of the PDF).

target.description: Where approved values are published: the data file of this sub-library, dataset type, bibId (source.bibId) and key.

datasetType.description: Dataset type of the published entries. It describes the data, not how they were transcribed: experimental values transcribed by AI are experiment.

facility.description: experiment only: facility (as listed in data/master/facilities.json) of a data file that does not exist yet.

by.description: Who published (the name the data entry tool records saves under).

contentHash.description: The approved content hash the entries were written from.

entryHash.description: entryHash of the entry as written (docs/id-definition.md).
